$comment: RELEASE ALLOWLIST for everything distributable (Phase 3.7 §9.6). DENY BY DEFAULT. Marker matching alone was not enough — a real client PNG carries no sentinel this project invented — and neither was an extension class: a stylesheet can embed an unmarked base64 data:image, which is artwork. So every file under a distributable static root must be either on `policy.exemptPaths` or listed here with a matching sha256, and every image/font/media file in the BUILD ARTEFACT must hash-match something listed here, whether it came from public/ or was bundled from source. `pnpm release:check` fails otherwise.

policy.exemptMeansNotArtwork: An exempt path is exempt from stating provenance, NOT from carrying art: an inlined base64 image payload in one still fails the build.
policy.artefactGate: Image, font, audio, video and SVG files in apps/web/.next (or out/dist) must hash-match an entry here. Next's own .rsc/.meta/chunk payloads are scaffolding, not art, and keep the marker and forbidden-path scan.
policy.whatTheScriptCanProve: That a provenance claim EXISTS and is bound to exact bytes. It cannot verify that the claim is true — a human reviewer does that. This is not proof of IP ownership.
policy.entryRequirements: path (normalised, inside a root, unique), sha256 (64 lowercase hex), non-empty author, non-empty licence.
